name: Docfarm
description: Docfarm turns anything Claude makes into a living, trackable document. Ask for a share link and Claude publishes the page to your farm in seconds; ask for a change and it patches the live doc in place (token friendly) — the link you already sent always shows the latest version. See who viewed each doc, which pages they read, and for how long. Duplicate and remix existing docs, protect them with passwords, invite collaborators, and draft follow-ups based on real engagement — without leaving the chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Docfarm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Docfarm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.doc.farm/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Docfarm MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Docfarm lists 22 MCP tools, including delete_doc, draft_followup, duplicate_doc, finalize_upload, get_doc_html, get_doc_status, get_doc_url, get_share_link, get_tracking_snippet, get_upload_url, host_html_content, and invite_collaborator.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Docfarm?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Docfarm in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Docfarm requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Docfarm is developed by Docfarm. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
